android_permissions_and_system_services: AccessibilityService solely for user-initiated remote control
Photo/media/file access via modern Android storage APIs
Foreground/background execution with user guidance to set battery use Unrestricted

store_screenshot_observations: Android app uses a dark dashboard, connection status, quick action tiles and paired-device cards.
Mac app uses a native-looking sidebar with feature destinations and a light content pane.
Messages use a thread list plus conversation detail layout.
Photos use a dense thumbnail grid; Files use a folder/item browser with drag/drop affordances.
Mirroring displays Android content in a desktop window and supports control.
Marketing screenshots explicitly show clipboard, photos, files, mirroring and webcam workflows.
